event_chain.summary: Employee recorded residents and shared videos

summary: Madison Russo, a 25-year-old former employee of Encore Memory Care in South Barrington, Illinois, was charged with unlawfully recording at least three residents between January and July 2026, including footage of residents naked, showering and using toilets, via Snapchat and sharing it with other employees in a group chat. The facility learned of it in June and fired six employees.
